title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, denoted as sigma, is used to model probabilities. It transforms any real-valued number into a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. This is useful for predicting probabilities in binary classification problems.

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: To find the linear combination for Billywine, substitute the given values into the expression $$\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv$$. Remember, $$\theta_1$$ and $$\theta_2$$ are the coefficients from your chosen theta vector.

title: Applying the Logistic Function
text: Once you have the linear combination, apply the logistic function: $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. This will give you the probability that Billywine is of type $$1$$.
